notes: CUDA timings exist only with --device on an actual GPU; without it the CUDA path is not timed (the tests check its emulated arena bit for bit against the CPU).

Every answer is an exact rational (precision: exact); the limbs L bound every intermediate integer (64 L bits); z_*_bits are the bit lengths of the reduced Z. The NumPy enumeration baseline is float64 and uncertified; its requests are checked exactly (exact_equal) against Python-integer enumeration.

Plans: 'complete' means the exact subset DP considered every order (at most 14 eliminated variables by default); larger models use the heuristic candidates (min-fill, min-degree, min-weight, weighted min-fill, natural, reverse) chosen by FND-008's cost (relative work units, not time).
